sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up officer facing slightly toward screen-left with blue-gray eyes and a restrained closed-mouth half smile. Very short brown-gray side hair, visible brown brows and a small neat thin brown upper-lip moustache with lightly upturned ends only; cheeks/jaw/chin remain bare without a beard. Distinctive tilted olive slouch-style hat with its broad brim dropping strongly toward screen-left and small brown textured tufts/plume details protruding above the crown; preserve actual hat silhouette and those visible details without inventing a central badge. Olive coat with shoulder straps/gold buttons, long red collar tabs with gold stripe/button ornament, gray-khaki shirt and black tie. Keep source pose, crop, lighting and full pale gray painted rectangular backing; source alpha230..255 recorded. Compact yellow mascot head with short broad neck fitted into the closed shirt collar.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up older moustached naval officer facing slightly toward screen-left, serious closed mouth, short neatly cut gray-brown side hair and gray brows. A broad dense silver-gray upper-lip moustache only, with bare cheeks/jaw/chin and no beard. Black/dark navy beret droops toward screen-left, olive-gray lower band and a small oval gold badge near upper screen-right; retain this beret variant. Dark navy lapelled service jacket with gold-buttoned shoulder tabs and tiny gold motifs, pale blue-gray closed shirt and dark navy/black tie. Maintain exact pose, crop, light and complete pale gray-green painted backing; source alpha249..255 is recorded. Fit the collar directly around a short broad mascot neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up clean-shaven older naval officer looking upward toward screen-left, solemn closed lips, thick dark-gray brows and short gray hair visible at temples below a white peaked naval cap. Keep upper lip, cheeks/jaw/chin bare without moustache or beard. Cap has a black band/visor, large central gold anchor-and-wreath badge and gold leaf embroidery along the visor. Dark navy uniform jacket with broad lapels, gold braided shoulder ornaments, pale blue-gray shirt and dark navy/black tie. Preserve this actual white-cap/navy-clothing variant, original lighting/crop and continuous pale gray-green painted rectangular background. Source alpha249..255 recorded; compact mascot head and very short broad neck naturally fitted in the closed collar.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Chest-up broadly grinning naval officer turned slightly toward screen-left with a clearly visible row of white teeth and deep smiling eye/cheek lines. Short brown side hair beneath a dark navy/black peaked cap, visible brown eyebrows and no moustache or beard; retain bare upper lip/jaw/chin and the single original toothy smile. Cap has a central gold anchor-and-wreath badge, a brown/gold leather strap across its dark band and a plain dark visor. Dark navy jacket with broad lapels and gold-buttoned shoulder tabs, pale gray shirt and black/dark navy tie. Keep exact cap/uniform variant, crop, light and full pale gray-green painted rectangular backing. Source alpha249..255 recorded; fit clothing around a compact broad yellow mascot head and short neck without a tall exposed column.
